newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi three-month T-Bill rate rises to 19.35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malawi three-month T-Bill rate rises to 19.35 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury Bills rose to 19.35 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 19.04 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Thursday.
Applications for 15.1 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at the average price of 95.63 kwacha percent.

The average rate for six-month bills increased to 19.25 percent from 18.48 percent two weeks ago. Applications for 12.98 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at the average price of 90.72 kwacha percent.

For nine-month bills, the average rate rose to 20.98 percent from 20.33 percent two weeks ago. Applications for 16.5 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at the average price of 85.96 kwacha percent.
